description: Return every rule in the pack: id, title, severity, the basis kind (direct clause / derived from principle / local configuration), the document and clause it cites, and whether the pack actually holds the verbatim clause text. The `coverage` object states how many rules carry a verbatim clause and how many record that the clause was not obtained, so a reader can weigh the report instead of trusting it. This is the answer to "how much of this is actually backed by a quoted regulation" — the number is computed from the pack, not asserted. Read-only, no parameters, no network, no writes.
name: customs_rulebook
title: List the rules and how many can quote their source
